description: This file defines the DebugControllerDispatcher class that acts as a dispatcher for the DebugController, handling events, method calls, and interactions between the DebugController object and external channels within the Playwright core server infrastructure.

classes.name: DebugControllerDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class for managing DebugController events and methods within the Playwright core server environment.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the dispatcher with a connection and a DebugController instance, setting up event listeners.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DebugController with provided parameters and progress reporting.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Sets the report state change enabled/disabled.

methods.name: setRecorderMode
methods.description: Sets the recorder mode on the DebugController.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights particular elements in the debugger context.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes execution from a paused state.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and disposes of the DebugController object.
